svg.title: The Vanilla Shop candle box: ZEST

text.textPath: LIGHT IT SLOWLY · BREATHE IN · LET THE DAY SOFTEN ·

text.tspan: Vanilla oil, beeswax, stearic acid, paraffin wax, parfum.
Store the candle away from direct sunlight. Keep it away from
dust and dirt. Avoid lighting in windy areas.
Do not leave a burning candle unattended. Keep away from
things that catch fire. Keep away from children and pets.
Trim the wick to ¼ inch before use. Dispose of contents and
